_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored and must never be committed.
_secret: JWT signing key. Must be at least 32 characters of random data. Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(48).toString('base64url'))"
_keys: Shared API keys the frontend sends as the x-key header. This is a deployment gate that keeps stray clients off the API — it is NOT an authentication control, because any value shipped to a browser bundle is readable by its users. Real authorization comes from the JWT.
_allowedOrigins: Exact origins permitted to make cross-origin calls to this API.
